content: MDN says IndexedDB transactions can help avoid concurrent-tab overwrites and browser storage can still be evicted. For local-only resume versions, use atomic data updates, schema/version migration, and a portable export/restore path; alert users before destructive deletion. Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/IndexedDB_API/Basic_Terminology ; https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Storage_API/Storage_quotas_and_eviction_criteria
